name: InputGroup
summary: The box that looks like a field and holds the control plus whatever is glued to it.

a11y.nota: o foco é do CONTROLE; o anel aparece na moldura por :focus-within, porque o contorno do campo de dentro ficaria escondido atrás da borda do grupo

props.name: width
props.description: Takes the group out of 100%: "20rem" for a measure, "auto" for the content size. With it the group also stops growing in a row.

props.name: aria-invalid
props.description: Goes to the field in the middle (not to the box): the group turns red like the other fields, and a screen reader hears "invalid". Inside a Field with error it arrives on its own; a field that says its own aria-invalid keeps it. Web only.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: Goes to the field in the middle (not to the box). Inside a Field it arrives on its own, pointing at the Field label; a field that sets its own aria-label or aria-labelledby keeps it. Web only.

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: Goes to the field in the middle (not to the box), added to the one it already has. Inside a Field it arrives on its own, pointing at the hint and the error message. Web only.
